reason: A chainlike stem, caudex or inflorescence is made of joints or swellings in a row, like links or beads. FLOPO:0991168 moniliform is defined as constricted at regular intervals like a string of beads.
A compound of two inflorescence values that both exist (corymb-like and umbelliform). It is read as a continuum between them, not as a new term.
Ebony or ebeneous means black like ebony, said of fern stipes. The 'ebúrneas'/'eburnea' examples mean ivory-white (PATO_0002149 ivory), were grouped here by mistake, and should be regrouped.

Floras use pot-shaped for urceolate: a capsule or endocarp swollen below and contracted towards the mouth, like the pyxidia of Lecythidaceae. If the mouth is not contracted, cup-shaped (PATO_0002227) would be the fallback.
Rostriform means beak-shaped. A rostriform style is drawn out into a narrow, beak-like point, which is the definition of FLOPO:0991028 beaked.

Saber-shaped (acinaciform) means curved like a sabre or scimitar. Of the existing terms, PATO falciform (scythe- or sickle-shaped) is the closest. The Spanish 'o sable' example on a banner petal may mean the colour sable (black) and should be checked.
Semi-shiny means somewhat shiny. That is the approximate-value pattern on PATO glistening (synonym shiny), not a separate quality.
Flowers that open only partly at anthesis. This is approximately open; a new term is not needed for 5 statements.

label: semitrullate
definition: A 2-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's outline being one half of a trullate figure divided lengthwise, with one side nearly straight and the other angled like half a trowel blade. NOTE: Sibling of FLOPO:0991336 trullate, FLOPO:0991318 semiovate and FLOPO:0991352 semisagittate.
reason: An asymmetric wing outline (half a trowel). It follows the half-shape classes already made from trullate's siblings; trullate itself cannot describe the asymmetry.
Strip-form means long, narrow and flat like a strip. PATO band shaped has strip-like and band-like as synonyms.
A relation to another named part: adnate (FLOPO:0991129) with 'towards' the rachis. This is pattern 09, not a new quality.
'Narrowed' already maps to tapered (rule C172), and 'gradually' is part of tapered's meaning. 'Basally' moves the bearer to the base of the organ (plant organ base FLOPO_0985024).
A corymbose panicle ('panículas corimbosas') is a panicle with a flat-topped, corymb-like outline. Both values exist, so it is a compound, not a new term.
The same compound as 'corymbiform-umbellate': two existing inflorescence values joined by a hyphen.
A compound of two existing PATO shapes: wedge-shaped below and fan-shaped above.
A low, broad cone. Both parts exist: depressed (FLOPO:0991103) and conical (PATO_0002021).

target: new: presence of a qualified part (awn PO_0025349 present, awn gland-tipped)
reason: The apex ends in an awn that carries a gland. 'Aristate' is already the rule 'awn present' (C207), and the gland is a quality of the awn, so this does not fit one term.
Lacerulate is the diminutive of lacerate: finely and irregularly torn. With 5 statements, a rule to lacerate is better than a new diminutive class.
A fragment of 'laxly few to several flowered'. It is an indefinite count of flowers (pattern 13) together with lax, which maps to PATO loose (rule C169).

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (continuum: linear PATO_0001199 / spatulate PATO_0001937, second value approximately)
reason: A compound of linear and nearly spatulate. Both values exist, and 'sub-' is the approximate qualifier of pattern 01.
Lobate is a variant of lobed, so this is FLOPO:0991158 palmately lobed.

Prickle-like stipules are narrow, rigid and sharp-pointed. That is the appearance FLOPO:0991230 spine-like defines; the developmental difference between prickle and spine does not matter for a resemblance quality.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (compound of two surface values: reticulate / pitted)
reason: A surface that is both net-ridged and deeply pitted (lacunose ≈ foveate PATO_0002296). This is a compound of two surface values; one new term would hide them.

Semiverticillate branches or segments are in incomplete or nearly whorls. Read as approximately whorled; FLOPO:0991310 pseudoverticillate (appearing whorled but not at one node) is the alternative reading.
A squashy stem gives way under pressure, which is PATO soft.
A stomach-shaped seed appendage is a swollen, bag-like sac. The nearest existing term is saccate (pouch- or bag-shaped); there is one source wording only.
Leathery is coriaceous (PATO_0104032), so subleathery is FLOPO:0991076 subcoriaceous.
An epichile or mid-lobe that is transversely dilated is widened sideways. This follows rule C182 (widened = increased width).

A transcription fragment that puts the part (the utricle) into the quality slot. The quality is globose = spherical (PATO_0001499), and the statement should be re-transcribed with the utricle as bearer.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (compound: lanate PATO_0104357 on the margin)
reason: The margin is fringed with woolly hairs: the woolly quality (PATO lanate) sits on the margin region. PATO ciliated is about cell cilia and must not be used.
